part.name: Pedestal-mounted C-frame bracket with threaded top boss
part.description: Single-piece mechanical bracket comprising an elongated two-hole mounting flange, a curved upright load frame, an open lower jaw or clevis cavity, paired side guide slots, a rectangular upper head, a transverse locating bore, and a reinforced axial threaded boss on top.
part.symmetry_note: The base flange, top boss, upper transverse bore, and many head features are approximately symmetric about the mid-thickness plane z=-21 mm. The longitudinal C-frame profile and lower jaw are not symmetric end-to-end. The two base mounting holes are positioned symmetrically near opposite ends of the 168 mm flange.

Section.name: Mounting base flange
Section.function intent: Mounts the bracket to a machine bed or support plate and establishes a stable positional datum.
Section.physical behavior: The broad flange bears against the support, while the two separated through holes accept fasteners and resist translation and rotation. The elongated footprint spreads upright-frame loads into the support and reduces local bearing stress.
Section.geometry: A long rectangular plate extending beyond both sides of the upright, with a constant 15 mm vertical thickness, semicylindrical corner rounds, two circular through holes, and broad parallel top and bottom faces.
Section.location: Bottom of the part, spanning the full x length and full z width.

Section.name: Curved upright load frame
Section.function intent: Carries loads between the upper functional head and the mounting flange while preserving a large side-access opening.
Section.physical behavior: The deep, thick C-shaped web behaves as a cantilevered frame. Its broad side faces resist bending, the curved outer spine transfers load around the opening, and the generous curved transitions reduce stress concentration at changes in section.
Section.geometry: A thick asymmetric C-frame rising from the base. It includes a broad planar front side, a corresponding back side, a large convex outer arc, a concave inner arch, and blended transitions into the base and upper head.
Section.location: Central portion of the part, above the base and below the upper head.

Section.name: Lower jaw and clevis cavity
Section.function intent: Provides side access and clearance for a mating component, workpiece, latch, or clamp member positioned inside the C-frame opening.
Section.physical behavior: The separated cheek regions laterally locate a mating part while leaving an open central volume. Flat and sloped internal faces can react contact loads, and the surrounding frame carries those loads back toward the mounting flange.
Section.geometry: An open clevis-like cavity near the lower part of the frame, bounded by two recessed planar cheek surfaces, vertical walls, short cylindrical end patches, and an inclined internal face.
Section.location: Lower central-left region of the upright, immediately above the base and inside the large C-shaped opening.

Section.name: Upper head block
Section.function intent: Supports and laterally locates the top threaded interface while providing a transverse pin or inspection bore.
Section.physical behavior: The deep rectangular head resists bending beneath the boss. The reduced central web limits mass while the thicker outer cheeks carry load. The transverse bore can accept a small pin, cross-fastener, or alignment feature.
Section.geometry: A box-like upper block with broad side faces, an inset central web, a small transverse radius-3 mm bore, and a rounded upper crown transitioning into the boss seat.
Section.location: Top of the upright frame, directly below the threaded boss.

Section.name: Paired side guide slots
Section.function intent: Provides guided travel, adjustment, visual access, or engagement for paired mating pins on opposite sides of the frame.
Section.physical behavior: The parallel slot walls constrain lateral motion, while the rounded ends provide travel limits and reduce stress concentration. The paired arrangement supports balanced loading on both side cheeks.
Section.geometry: Two matching obround pockets or slots located on opposite outer cheeks. Each has two straight vertical walls, semicylindrical radius-9 mm ends, and a planar recessed floor.
Section.location: Lower-to-middle region of the frame cheeks, one slot visible from the front and the other from the back.

Section.name: Threaded top boss and reinforcement
Section.function intent: Provides the primary axial attachment for a threaded actuator, stud, adjustment screw, fitting, or mating cylindrical component.
Section.physical behavior: The cylindrical boss locates the mating member concentrically, and its internal bore carries axial and torsional thread loads. The annular top face supplies a seating datum, while the toroidal and blended base transitions distribute those loads into the upper head.
Section.geometry: A vertical cylindrical boss centered on the head, with an approximately 7.0175 mm-radius internal bore, a chamfered bore entrance, an outer radius-12 mm cylinder, and a flared reinforced base composed of toroidal and blended patches.
Section.location: Topmost central feature of the part, with its axis parallel to the vertical y direction.
